blockingIssues.description: Dashboard hero localization is still incomplete because `dashboard.hero.today`, `dashboard.hero.alertCount_*`, `dashboard.hero.allClear`, and `dashboard.hero.attentionNeeded` were added only in `src/i18n/locales/en.ts`; the `hi` and `mr` locale files still fall back to English for the redesigned hero copy.

Farm detail localization remains incomplete because `app/farm/[id].tsx` still hardcodes labels like `Soil Water`, `Days Pruned`, `Log Entries`, and `Total records`, and `farmDetails.safeHarvest.inlineTitle` exists only in `en`, so non-English locales still regress to English.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated `.factory/library/architecture.md` so typography guidance matches the shipped onboarding fix: the repo currently uses a Georgia/serif fallback for onboarding headlines because Fraunces is not bundled.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify the i18n boundary rule for redesign work: when a feature introduces new user-facing copy, workers must either reuse existing translation keys or update all supported locale files together. `src/i18n/` cannot remain categorically off-limits if locale parity is required to satisfy the mission.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The rerun fix feature edited `src/i18n/locales/en.ts` to add new dashboard/farm-detail keys, but `hi.ts` and `mr.ts` were left behind, while `AGENTS.md` still marks `src/i18n/` as off-limits. The structural fix review also noted new hardcoded English farms-summary text slipping in under the same boundary confusion.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Strengthen recovery and procedure-compliance rules so fix workers always leave a reviewable evidence trail: required skills must be invoked (or deviations explicitly reported), and crash/manual-recovery paths must still emit usable handoff/transcript metadata.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `fix-core-screens-i18n-a11y-tokens` review had to reconstruct the change from `progress_log.jsonl` and git history because neither worker session produced a handoff/transcript artifact, while the `fix-core-screens-structural` review found a handoff claiming full procedure compliance even though the transcript did not show the required `ui-worker` invocation.

rejectedObservations.observation: Promote the farm-detail overlay visual-fidelity note into a shared guidance update.
rejectedObservations.reason: Rejected because it is a feature-specific polish gap rather than a systemic process or shared-state issue; it belongs in the individual review report, not shared guidance.

rejectedObservations.observation: Create a separate shared guidance update just for the farms-list summary line hardcoding English text.
rejectedObservations.reason: Rejected as redundant because the broader i18n-boundary guidance already captures the underlying systemic problem of new redesign copy bypassing locale parity.
